input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, guaranteed volume, take-or-pay hosting fee or shortfall penalty on the Company. Compensation under Section 3 is purely a 30% revenue share on actual Net Sales, and only on Net Sales above $11,000 per calendar month, so the Company pays nothing absent sales — i.e., fees are for actual usage/results only, which meets the preferred position. There are also no volume caps on the Company's usage of the Site. The term (Section 4.1) is a single one-year term auto-renewing annually with a 90-day termination right, so no multi-year lock-in. Noted but not flagged here: the Section 4.2 Termination Payment payable if the Company terminates is an exit/termination fee rather than a minimum-volume commitment (and it is formula-based, capped at zero on the downside), so it belongs to the termination-fee rule rather than MINCOMMIT; the Section 6.1 exclusivity restricts the Company's participation in similar projects but is a non-compete restriction, not a purchase commitment or usage volume cap.
